title: Perón and Argentina
goal: Follow Perón's rise and fall in Argentina, telling the story with the preterite and the imperfect.

items: I can tell how Perón gained the support of the workers.
I can describe what happened on 17 October 1945.
I can say what Eva Perón did and when she died.
I can explain how Perón's government ended in 1955.
I can tell a past story with the preterite for events and the imperfect for the background.
